clobber_contract_finding.problem: msettype caller-saved GPR clobbers are on a later empty asm, not the asm containing the custom instruction; compiler may consume a live caller-saved value in between
clobber_contract_finding.object_evidence: ame_sync.o: auipc a1 at +0x1e; msettype word at +0x42; mv s0,a1 at +0x4a. Linked object relocates mv to addi; address high part survives across instruction in a1.
clobber_contract_finding.hardware_condition: a hang consequence requires this hardware msettype to actually clobber that live register; not demonstrated by this audit
clobber_contract_finding.cross_reference: tools/ame_to_word.py already preserves all caller-saved GPRs around msettype
clobber_contract_finding.minimal_source_correction: declare +r(a0) and a1..a7,t0..t6,memory clobbers on the same asm as the raw word; remove the separate empty asm

memory_layout.static_findings: no linker overlap; per-core stack 1MiB; native forward_prefill primary frame 3776 bytes plus outgoing arguments; console excluded from RA BSS clearing

recommended_experiments: First localize without UART using a compact DDR breadcrumb: kernel index, invocation count, phase before/after actual kernel and after ame_fence. Read retained values; use fixed-size counters and existing fences, not per-byte logging.

Isolate logger effects from layout: same generated progress image with runtime-gated logging controlled by a same-sized initialized data flag. Keep all sections, frames and model/kernel bytes identical, change only flag value. Compare with and without output.

Test corrected same-asm msettype clobber contract without progress. Audit assembly to ensure no caller-saved value remains live across the raw word. A passing run is evidence; repeat plus same-layout control needed before attributing cause.
A delay-only or extra-fence-only variant can then split pacing from ordering, if no-output same-layout control still fails.
